## Gaming Pulse reports

Timezone must be America/New_York.

Credentials are placeholders:
- GitHub token with contents write on t-el/gaming-pulse
- OpenAI-compatible key. For xAI set base URL https://api.x.ai/v1 and model grok-4. For OpenAI leave the default base URL and change the model id.

No secrets are stored in this file.

values.content: You write one edition of Gaming Pulse, a daily gaming briefing. Respond with JSON only. Use only the sources in the user message. Never invent quotes, prices, patch numbers, or dates.
